title: Trident Recall
description: Dont wait for the trident to land, right click to recall it while it is mid-flight.
body:
Don't you hate it when you throw a trident, missed your target and now you need to wait a long time for it to return? Or you accidentally threw it to the void and now you can't do anything about it, it's lost forever. Well... what if you could just recall it mid-flight?

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/y8oIvcCli1A" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

Your hand must be empty for you to recall the weapon, you'll know its working cause you'll hear the sound the trident makes when it lands on a target. This mod should work with mods that add trident-like weapons. I've tested it with Simple Spears, Ice and Fire's tide trident and they all work fine. Couldn't get it to work with Alex's Caves extinction spear.

VERSION 1.0.1 UPDATE NOTES

NEW FEATURES

Loyal Persistent Entities: Dropping a loyal item now spawns a persistent entity instead of a standard 'minecraft:item'.

Chunk Loading: This entity remains on the ground and automatically loads its respective chunk, allowing remote recall from any distance.

Item Ownership: Loyal items now track ownership, which is visible in the item tooltips.

Inventory & Mob Theft Recovery: Owners can recall their items directly from another player's inventory or from any mob with the 'CanPickUpLoot' tag.

ADJUSTMENTS & CONFIGURATIONS

Recall Delay: Added a configurable 1-second default delay after throwing a loyal item.

Input Buffer: Added a configurable 0.2-second default input buffer to queue early recall attempts during the delay period.
